title: Proposer une mise à jour mémoire

actions.code: const s0={{ json .source_file }}; const p={{ json .proposal }}; const raw=typeof s0==="string"?s0:(s0&&typeof s0.content==="string"?s0.content:JSON.stringify(s0)); let d; try{d=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){throw new Error("source_invalid")} if(d.source_id!==p.source_id||typeof d.content!=="string"||!d.content.includes(p.evidence_quote)) throw new Error("evidence_or_source_mismatch"); return {ok:true};

const fs={{ json .files }}; const r={{ json .proposal }}; const p="/company-memory/proposal-"+r.proposal_id+".json"; if(!Array.isArray(fs)) throw new Error("storage_listing_unavailable"); if(fs.some(f=>f&&f.path===p)) throw new Error("proposal_already_exists"); if(r.previous_revision && !fs.some(f=>f&&f.path==="/company-memory/proposal-"+r.previous_revision+".json")) throw new Error("previous_revision_missing"); return {path:p};
